verifications.claim: As of March 20, 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage refinance rates hovered around 6.25% to 6.79%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R3 provides 6.24% (approx 6.25%) for 30yr refi; R9 exactly 6.79% for 30yr refi on March 20; range directly supported.

verifications.claim: As of March 20, 2026, 15-year fixed mortgage refinance rates sat between 5.5% and 5.91%.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: '15-year fixed: 5.77%' (refi), purchase/Freddie 5.54%-5.65%; R9: '15-Year Fixed Refinance: 5.91%' (March 20); R7: '15-year fixed-mortgage rate is 5.64 percent' (purchase March 19)
verifications.reasoning: High 5.91% matches R9 refi; low 5.5% matches purchase/Freddie rates, not refi (refi rates 5.77%+); misattributes purchase to refi.

verifications.claim: As of March 19-20, 2026, 30-year fixed refinance rates were 6.16%–6.79%.

verifications.reasoning: Low 6.16% exactly R3 purchase, not refi (refi 6.24%); high 6.79% refi ok, but low misattributed to refi.
